reviews.title: Flash BIOS early, doubt tech support.
reviews.comment: This is a review of the product, not the seller. Seller was great. I set the CPU, memory, m.2 drives and power, booted up and got a mem error. Dropped memory from 256GB to 128 and it booted. Contacted customer support and was told I needed to pirchase a 4 DIMM kit instead of two 2 DIMM kits to make it work. That, of course, is nonsense. Flashing to the latest BIOS fixed recognition of memory over 128GB, but it ships with a deficient BIOS and poor tech support from ASRock.
reviews.author: Thomas B.
